source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test helper assigns its supplied openpgpSink directly to the channel. The test object's complete definition records updateSecurityStatus but has no processUnobtrusiveSignature method. Native mixed-part EOF calls that method for unobtrusive signatures, and the production UI sink performs detached verification there. The fixture conversion and zero-result assertions therefore do not directly assert the production positive-verification path. Native wrapper behavior and runtime consequences were not tested.
title: The MIME test sink does not wire unobtrusive signature verification
